name: dosebot
tagline: Tells you whether your idea is a nice-to-have or a genuine ache
description: Pitch it a company, a product or a single feature and it sorts the thing into one of three buckets: something people merely enjoy having, something that relieves real pain, or a blend of the two. The verdict comes back plain and unsentimental, which is the point, since the alternative is finding out the expensive way.
author: onerinas
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
